effects: Burns the `shares` amount of the signer's sUSDe.
Moves previewRedeem(shares) USDe from the vault to the silo and adds it to the signer's pending cooldown amount.
Sets the end of the signer's cooldown to now plus cooldownDuration, for the whole pending amount, including USDe already in cooldown.
The signer can claim the USDe only later, with unstake, after the cooldown ends.
formats.shown: The screen shows 'Cooldown Shares' and the sUSDe amount that the transaction burns.

findings.title: cooldownShares restarts the cooldown timer for USDe already in cooldown, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.cooldownShares: `cooldowns[msg.sender].cooldownEnd = uint104(block.timestamp) + cooldownDuration; cooldowns[msg.sender].underlyingAmount += uint152(assets);`. The descriptor shows only intent "Cooldown Shares" and the field 'Amount' (#.shares).
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Start cooldown; restarts any pending cooldown", or add an interpolatedIntent such as "Unstake {shares}; resets timer of pending cooldown".

findings.title: cooldownShares uses the jargon intent 'Cooldown Shares' and does not say the USDe comes later through unstake.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "Cooldown Shares", interpolatedIntent null. In StakedUSDeV2.cooldownShares, `_withdraw(msg.sender, address(silo), msg.sender, assets, shares)` sends the USDe to the silo, not to the signer.
findings.fix: Set intent "Start unstaking sUSDe" and interpolatedIntent "Start cooldown to unstake {shares}". Label the field 'sUSDe to unstake'.

findings.title: cooldownShares does not show the USDe amount that the signer can claim later, because it comes from the exchange rate.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.cooldownShares: `assets = previewRedeem(shares);`. Case 0 moves 1853468.8 USDe to the silo (signer null), and no field shows this amount.

cases.notes: The screen shows the sUSDe burn of 1515266.44 right. The USDe moved to the silo for the signer's claim does not appear, but that amount depends on the exchange rate.

effects: Burns previewWithdraw(assets) of the signer's sUSDe, rounded up.
Moves `assets` USDe from the vault to the silo and adds it to the signer's pending cooldown amount.
Sets the end of the signer's cooldown to now plus cooldownDuration, for the whole pending amount, including USDe already in cooldown.
The signer can claim the USDe only later, with unstake.
formats.shown: The screen shows 'Cooldown Assets' and a USDe 'Amount', which is the USDe that goes into cooldown.

findings.title: cooldownAssets restarts the cooldown timer for USDe already in cooldown, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.cooldownAssets: `cooldowns[msg.sender].cooldownEnd = uint104(block.timestamp) + cooldownDuration; cooldowns[msg.sender].underlyingAmount += uint152(assets);`. The descriptor shows only intent "Cooldown Assets" and the field 'Amount'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Start cooldown; restarts any pending cooldown".

findings.title: cooldownAssets labels the USDe value 'Amount', so the signer may think USDe leaves the wallet.
findings.evidence: descriptor field label "Amount", token 0x4c9EDD...68B3 (USDe), path #.assets. In StakedUSDeV2.cooldownAssets, sUSDe is burned from the signer and the USDe is credited to the cooldown.
findings.fix: Label the field "USDe to claim after cooldown". Set intent "Start unstaking sUSDe" and interpolatedIntent "Unstake sUSDe for {assets} after cooldown".

findings.title: cooldownAssets does not show the sUSDe that it burns, because the exchange rate sets that amount.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.cooldownAssets: `shares = previewWithdraw(assets); ... _withdraw(msg.sender, address(silo), msg.sender, assets, shares);`

effects: Sends the signer's whole pending cooldown amount of USDe from the silo to `receiver`.
Sets the signer's pending cooldown amount and end time to zero.
formats.shown: The screen shows 'Unstake' and the receiver address, but no asset and no amount.

findings.title: unstake uses the intent 'Unstake', which does not name USDe and makes the blind reader expect sUSDe to leave.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "Unstake". StakedUSDeV2.unstake only calls `silo.withdraw(receiver, assets)`. In case 1, the reader wrote 'staked token (likely sUSDe) from my wallet', but the only signer effect is USDe in.
findings.fix: Set intent "Claim USDe after cooldown" and interpolatedIntent "Claim cooled-down USDe to {receiver}".

findings.title: unstake does not show the USDe amount that the receiver gets, because it comes from storage.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.unstake: `uint256 assets = userCooldown.underlyingAmount; ... silo.withdraw(receiver, assets);`. In case 1 the signer receives 377.267452 USDe, and the screen shows no amount.

findings.title: unstake limits the receiver addressName types to eoa and wallet, but any address can receive the USDe.
findings.evidence: descriptor unstake field 'Receiver' params types ["eoa","wallet"]. StakedUSDeV2.unstake accepts any `address receiver`.
findings.fix: Remove the `types` restriction on the Receiver field, or add "contract".

cases.notes: The signer receives 377.27 USDe. The screen shows the receiver right, but no asset and no amount. The reader guessed USDe and also wrongly expected sUSDe to leave.

couldNotCheck: Whether the signer in case 0 already had a pending cooldown, so I could not confirm the timer reset from a mined case.
IStakedUSDeCooldown and the other interface files are omitted (14 sources omitted), so I could not check the UserCooldown struct layout.
